source_documents.title: Modifying the AIE-TADF chromophore with host-substituents to achieve high efficiency and low roll-off non-doped OLEDs

reference_evidence_units.quote: They all showed obvious solvatochromic, which indicated strong CT state in these four molecules.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four emitters including mPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solvent-dependent emission, main Figure 3b specifically shows the meta target.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source assigns core CT character from solvatochromism.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not infer TICT geometry or assign peripheral carbazole groups to the CT channel.

reference_evidence_units.quote: host-substituents didn’t participate in intramolecular charge transfer.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four emitters including mPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.statement: The peripheral covalent host substituents are excluded from the CT channel.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Self-host design is not supramolecular guest binding.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The PL intensities of pPhDCzDPSPXZ and mPhDCzDPSPXZ were increased by 6.4–6.7 times
reference_evidence_units.subject: Para and meta emitters
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 90% water relative to THF; main Figure 3c shows the meta target.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The pair shows a 6.4-6.7-fold aggregation-associated increase.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not assign an endpoint of this range to one compound without curve-based quantification.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the molecular rotations were restricted more easily when the water content was increased.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Para and meta emitters
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Authors' explanation of stronger AIE in the N-linked pair.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source attributes enhanced emission to easier motion restriction.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Solvation and aggregation change together; this is a bounded mechanistic interpretation.

reference_evidence_units.subject: mPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.statement: Prompt/delayed lifetimes are 55.2/765.0 ns; prompt/delayed yields 29/27%, total 56%, peak 548 nm. Derived kRISC and Kf are 6.8 x 10^5 and 5.4 x 10^6 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Rates and yield decomposition use the source model; missing SI derivations are not revalidated.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The delayed component exhibited a clear temperature dependence effect
reference_evidence_units.subject: mPhDCzDPSPXZ shown in Figure 4a; other emitters in SI
reference_evidence_units.statement: The displayed target has a temperature-dependent delayed component.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Temperature dependence is interpreted jointly with oxygen response and prompt/delayed kinetics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the intensity of the delayed portion was obviously increased after oxy­ gen removal.
reference_evidence_units.subject: mPhDCzDPSPXZ shown in Figure 4b; other emitters in SI
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Neat-film fluorescence decay in nitrogen versus air.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The main-figure target shows enhanced delayed emission after oxygen removal.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not label phosphorescence solely from oxygen sensitivity.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The introduction of host-substituents didn’t participate in ICT but functioned on dispersing excitons
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four emitters including mPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Authors' interpretation of covalent self-host groups.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The peripheral groups are assigned an exciton-dispersing role.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No separate binding complex or resolved excimer channel is demonstrated.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Motion restriction is central to the proposed AIE mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The core CT state is supported, with peripheral groups explicitly excluded.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Prompt/delayed contributions and derived rISC support state-utilization analysis, overlapping the TADF account.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Target-specific delayed, temperature- and oxygen-dependent emission supports the source TADF account.
